name: BreakContact
teaser: Everything you always wanted in SPT
description_html:
This mod started as a small mod to improve the efficacy of smoke grenades, and just sort of mushroomed into a bunch of things I’ve always wanted for SPT (cheers to AI workflows). Thus, this mod is a grab bag of mods that you can switch on/off individually.

Features:

  • Smoke grenades have been made more effective, when a smoke fires off the game now adds bush-style colliders around the smoke to manually hamper bots’ vision. It’s now viable to actually use to, for example, BREAK CONTACT with enemy bots. (https://youtu.be/qJ2U5ce6mqE)

  • SAIN bots, if you have SAIN installed, will aggressively throw their smoke grenades if you force them into a retreat state.

  • Quest items have a small white dot above them in raid, dot size adjustable.

  • Friendly bots have a small blue dot above their heads in raid, dot size adjustable (shares size with the quest dot). These dots only work if you have direct line of sight to the friendly bot.

  • Firing a white flare into the air will summon the train, if the map has a train.

  • If you are using Realism, AquaPeps can be combined with drink items that may poison you to reduce the likelyhood of poisoning you.

  • Weapons that you a) buy from traders and b) find in world are no longer perfect condition weapons. Older and cheaper weapons tend to have lower durability, whereas newer ones have higher durability. I find this way more immersive.
